name: Menu Link Revisions
description: Provides revision management for menu links (history of changes to menu link content).
project_description:
Menu Link Revisions brings Drupal's powerful revision management system to menu items, providing functionality similar to node revisions. This module enables content teams to:

 
 Track every change to menu links with full revision history 
 Revert to previous versions of menu items 
 Maintain draft and published states using the existing "enabled" field 
 Manage access with granular permissions 
 
 By adding robust version control to menus, this module helps maintain accurate navigation structures and simplifies recovery from accidental changes or unwanted modifications.
